mp_gga.provenance: planning estimate: GGA-level static DFT relaxation+bands at high-throughput database scale, order 10-100 CPU-core-hours per material (typical MP/JARVIS/SNUMAT workflow scale); assumption, not measured microdata

mp_gga_expsynth.provenance: planning estimate: GGA-level static DFT relaxation+bands at high-throughput database scale, order 10-100 CPU-core-hours per material (typical MP/JARVIS/SNUMAT workflow scale); assumption, not measured microdata (same GGA workflow, experimentally synthesizable subset)

snumat_gga.provenance: planning estimate: GGA-level static DFT relaxation+bands at high-throughput database scale, order 10-100 CPU-core-hours per material (typical MP/JARVIS/SNUMAT workflow scale); assumption, not measured microdata

jarvis_optb88vdw.provenance: planning estimate: GGA-level static DFT relaxation+bands at high-throughput database scale, order 10-100 CPU-core-hours per material (typical MP/JARVIS/SNUMAT workflow scale); assumption, not measured microdata (OptB88vdW is a GGA-class vdW functional)

mp_r2scan.provenance: planning estimate: r2SCAN meta-GGA static workflow, roughly 2-3x GGA cost per material; assumption, not measured microdata

jarvis_mbj.provenance: planning estimate: TBmBJ is a cheap potential-only correction on a converged density, near-GGA cost per material; assumption, not measured microdata

snumat_hse.provenance: planning estimate: HSE06 hybrid-functional band structure, 30-100x GGA cost per material; assumption, not measured microdata

expt_zhuo.provenance: planning estimate: experimental band gap = powder synthesis + diffuse-reflectance/UV-Vis measurement + analysis per sample; assumption, not measured microdata

cost_table_note: planning-grade order-of-magnitude assumptions with stated provenance, operator-adjustable via --cost-json; NOT measured microdata. Receiver-native currencies (CPU-core-hours vs person+instrument-hours) are never converted into each other; usd_illustration_mid is a labelled illustration only.
method: per seed: reuse tau at the early-window end (budget 120) -> linearly interpolated budget at which the matched-seed cold curve (anchored at budget 0, tau 0) reaches it; never -> max budget, censored; evaluations_saved = cold budget - early budget
